body: my ear still snags on the first line of Love Story (Taylor's Version). same balcony song, grown-up Taylor, i melt every time!! one-minute challenge: open the Taylor's Version lens and find which re-record has the biggest vault. no googling 💛 https://www.longlivets.com/?lens=taylors-version&utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=thread
why: Nov 21 Taylor's Version thread hero (interactive-challenge). X written first; its challenge (biggest vault) differs from IG's. Answer is in the lens: Red (Taylor's Version), 9 vault tracks (supabase/seed/lenses/rerecords.mjs rr-red). Photo is Taylor singing Love Story from the balcony on the Speak Now tour.

critique.rationale: Executes the hero slot's challenge angle: the snag moment first, then one findable task whose answer (Red, 9 vault tracks) is in the lens. The balcony photo is Love Story itself, so the image carries the feeling line.
